title: Research image editing libraries and capabilities
acceptance_criteria: Identified top 3 libraries for canvas-based image editing (e.g., Fabric.js, Konva.js, PixiJS)
Libraries support format conversion (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF)
Libraries support metadata reading/writing (EXIF, IPTC, XMP)
Libraries support crop, rotate, resize, brightness, contrast, saturation
